summary.method: Two independent fresh blind reviewers on disjoint three-case blocks

block_summaries.dimension_applicability: Edit restraint is not scored: these are generation tasks with source notes, not edits of supplied finished prose. Preservation of useful detail and uncertainty is scored under fidelity and reader relevance.

exact_checks.criterion: At most 170 words including subject and sign-off

block_summaries.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words; all outputs also pass using word-like token counts.
block_summaries.unsupported_claim_review: No unsupported specifications, personal circumstances, measured savings, success guarantees, discounts or fulfillment commitments were found. The absence of a staff-time baseline supports the time-saving limitation; unresolved retry and repeated-submission notes support the production cautions.
block_summaries.evaluation_feedback: The 301 and 303 assertion lists omit their explicit word limits; independent exact checks above cover them. No substantive assertion gap was observed.
block_summaries.interpretation: These ties establish equivalent usable output on the reviewed cases, not demonstrated improvement or population-level superiority.

exact_checks.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited tokens including Markdown headings; all also remain within requested limits if headings are excluded.
exact_checks.titles_and_quantities: Requested case-304 title and all material quantities, dates, times, costs and ownership conditions checked against supplied fictional records.

block_summaries.beyond_assertions: Checked the full outputs for omitted operating conditions, first-time-user usability, unsupported claims, sanitized failure history, invented phone-user motives, comparative rates and savings, unproven export reversibility, and changed owners/commitments. No additional material defect found. Case 305 B's inactive-monitoring warning is a supported implication; case 306's numerical-threshold wording does not invent a threshold.
block_summaries.eval_feedback: Assertions cover the main risks well. Case 304's bundled return assertion does not individually enumerate equipment-in-use handling or directing disputed borrowers to receipt contact details; both outputs preserve these conditions, and they were checked beyond the assertion. No gap changes the verdicts.
block_summaries.interpretation: The two minor preferences are local editorial judgments. Equivalent coverage and scores do not demonstrate overall superiority. No labels or source implementations were inferred.
